coca.p: [Cu+ca] (na) CL=10 cu- cavane,...cavati rukkhāti cocaṃ. Ṇvādi. 39.] (1) Banana tree. See-cocaṃgahana. (2) Bananas with seeds; Wild bananas. (3) Banana juice with seeds; Wild banana juice.
